gitCommit.subject: Correct two stale claims in the stack list
gitCommit.body:
Correct two stale claims in the stack list

Devise is not in the Gemfile and never was on this branch of the history. Auth
is Rails 8 primitives: has_secure_password with a plain session for the web,
JWT for the API, omniauth for Google and a hand-written authenticator for
Apple. A session trusting that line would go looking for Devise mailer views
and initializers that do not exist, which is exactly what happened while
checking whether the mailer layout covers every email.

Mobile was worse. It read "planned: Hotwire Native", while the app is React
Native and Expo and has been on the App Store for weeks.

Neither claim is load-bearing for the code, which is the problem: nothing fails
loudly when the file lies, it just misdirects whoever reads it next.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
